functions.title: Search tasks
functions.description: Search tasks visible to the delegated user, including personal-task privacy rules, with overdue, deal, contact, due-date range and due-date sort filters.

completeness.notes: Follows workspace scope, task sharing and personal-task privacy; at most limit rows are returned. overdue is evaluated against the start of today in the given timezone (UTC when omitted).

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { query?: string; status?: string; overdue?: boolean; dealId?: string; contactId?: string; dueFrom?: string; dueTo?: string; sort?: 'asc' | 'desc'; timezone?: string; limit?: number }): Promise<TaskSearchResult>;

functions.title: Search calendar events
functions.description: Search bounded native calendar event rows visible to the delegated user, by explicit from/to or by a range shortcut (today, this_week, next_7_days).

completeness.notes: Returns stored CalendarEvent rows capped by limit; recurrence rules are not expanded. A range shortcut is resolved as a half-open window in the given timezone (UTC when omitted) and echoed in window.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args: ({ from: string; to: string } | { range: 'today' | 'this_week' | 'next_7_days'; timezone?: string }) & { limit?: number }): Promise<CalendarSearchResult>; // from..to <= 90 days; result may carry window: { from, to, timezone }

functions.title: Search activities
functions.description: Search bounded activities visible to the delegated user, optionally within a date range and sorted by date.

completeness.notes: At most twenty scoped activities are returned; the query matches titles only and activity notes are neither searched nor included.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { query?: string; type?: string; dealId?: string; contactId?: string; from?: string; to?: string; sort?: 'asc' | 'desc' }): Promise<ActivitySearchResult>;

functions.title: Search notes
functions.description: Search the delegated user's general notes (personal or tenant-shared notes that are not attached to a deal, contact, activity, account, meeting or chat thread). Returns titles only.

completeness.notes: Follows workspace scope; personal notes are owner-only. At most twenty notes are returned and note bodies are never included. CRM-linked notes belong to the CRM package.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { query?: string; noteType?: string }): Promise<NoteSearchResult>;
